title: After Dune Delight | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Towering 4 stories and boasting over 4,000 square feet, the newly renovated After Dune Delight is perfect for weddings and other functions. It has 6 large bedrooms, a private pool, stellar gulf views, and close proximity to the beach access and Red Bar.
description_expanded: Description: After Dune Delight by Royal Destinations Location: Grayton Beach Address: 215 Garfield Street Details: Welcome to After Dune Delight, a stunning four-story coastal retreat designed for unforgettable gatherings along 30A. With six spacious bedrooms, all-new bedding and décor, and room to comfortably accommodate up to 22 guests, this home offers the perfect blend of style, comfort, and space. Enjoy stellar views from expansive wrap-around balconies, where four sets of glass doors open to reveal breathtaking vistas of Western Lake and the Gulf of Mexico. The private pool, generous living area, and multiple outdoor spaces create an ideal setting for relaxation and entertaining. Perfectly situated within view of the beach access and just across the street from Grayton Beach’s beloved landmark, The Red Bar, this home places you in the heart of one of 30A’s most iconic destinations. Whether you’re planning a family reunion, group getaway, wedding, or special event, After Dune Delight delivers the ultimate Grayton Beach experience—where coastal luxury meets laid-back charm. If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: -Distance to Beach Access: 380 Yards -Parking Spaces: 6 -Dining Accommodations: Table for 10 and Bar Seating for 4 -Coffee Maker Available -Propane Grill -Elevator (Ground Floor Exterior Entrance) -Private Saltwater Pool: 13’ x 30’ -Small Events Welcome- Approval is required; please contact our team for further information. Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps: 22 6 Beds / 6.5 Baths First Floor: -Bedroom 1: (2) Queen/Full Bunk Beds with Shared Bath (Shower) Second Floor: -Bedroom 2: (2) Queen Beds with Private Bath (Shower) -Bedroom 3: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower/Tub Combo) -Bedroom 4: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) Third Floor: -Kitchen / Dining Area / Living Room -Half Bath -Laundry Room Fourth Floor: -Bedroom 5 (Master): King Bed with Private Bath (Soaking Tub and Shower) -Bedroom 6: (2) Queen Beds with Private Bath (Shower) Amenities Include: -6 Adult Bikes Please Note: *Nearby construction is underway. *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. *The dumbwaiter is not operational. *The pool is not able to be heated. Home Sweet Home: A Note From The Homeowner- We toured nearly 30 homes along 30A, Sandestin, and Destin, but After Dune Delight stood out instantly—it had everything we wanted: wraparound porches, stunning views of the Gulf and Western Lake, and that breezy, coastal charm. Just a block from the beach and across from the iconic Red Bar, it's like a front-row seat to all things Grayton—including Tribe Kelley concerts. With plenty of space, parking, and the perfect layout for hosting, it felt made for memory-making. We love the wraparound porches most—they're where mornings, sunsets, and music-filled evenings happen. Grayton Beach itself adds to the magic with its quirky, small-town vibe, barefoot bike rides, and unbeatable walkability. Adding an elevator made the home even better, giving easy access to all four floors and those top-level views. It’s the heart of 30A with its own soul—laid-back, welcoming, and unforgettable. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
